hook: Your map of India hangs on a strip about 22 km wide.
title: India's map hangs on a 22 km strip
description: The Siliguri Corridor in West Bengal is only about 22 km wide at its narrowest. It links India's northeast to the rest of the country. Nepal, Bhutan and Bangladesh squeeze in around it, which is why it is nicknamed the Chicken's Neck.
